versions.changelog: Anonymous amazon.es only. Cookie capture and other-store scrapers removed from the zip. Actor id no longer configurable.
Anonymous default enforced; Amazon-only HTTPS; extra stores and arbitrary imports removed.
Initial ClawHub release. Opinionated Amazon shopper: session-cookie replay over plain HTTP, spec decoding, per-unit price normalisation, and multi-phrasing sweeps rather than trusting one keyword.
